blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. has declared special nonworking days in 18 municipalities and five cities across the country from November 2026 to January 2027, to allow residents to participate in local celebrations and commemorations. The declarations cover founding and charter anniversaries, local festivals, and historical events, including the martyrdom of revolutionary hero Gen. Gregorio del Pilar and the liberation of Mindoro Island from Japanese occupation. Executive Secretary Ralph Recto signed all 23 proclamations on Nov. 23, by authority of Marcos.
